Shanghai File B.6704A
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. I. P. (1935)

D.S. Tcherkashansky

Lev Constantinovitch Trofimoff, Lithuanian citizen of Russian origin, born on August 18, 1887 at Kamishin, Saratov Province, arrived in Shanghai from Harbin at the end of November 1934 and became a partner in "Oriental Motors", No.126 Bubbling Well Road, owned by Messrs. M. B. Tark and V. M. Koffman. Trofimoff was registered with local Bureau of Public Safety under No. 15512 on November 30, 1934 as a Lithuanian citizen, on the strength of Lithuanian Certificate of Nationality issued in Harbin by the former Lithuanian Consul Kotyl-Kotylius. It is known that Kotyl-Kotylius would issue certificates of nationality to anybody for certain remuneration (File D.6827). In this connection it must be noted that when he registered with the Bureau of Public Safety, Trofimoff falsely stated the place of birth as Radsivillishky, Lithuania.

Trofimoff rented Apt. 3, Daisy Apartments, No. 20 Route Camil Lories. Some time later his wife Nina Mikhailovna Trofimoff, born on 3.6.1900 in Tomsk, Siberia, arrived in Shanghai. With them resided also the young sister of Mrs. Trofimoff, name unknown.

Trofimoff came to the notice of S.M.P. in connection with the case of Eriam Haidis, who was arrested in Hankow by the Chinese Authorities for being concerned in the plot to liberate Walden-Rivesh - agent of the 3rd International - from the Chinese prison at Hankow. It was reported that Trofimoff, who is a good chess player, was seen several times in the company of Walden-Rivesh, playing chess. Eriam Haidis in his statement alleged that Trofimoff was a Soviet Agent, and was introduced to him by V. [blacked out], [blacked out] of the Shipping Department of the local branch of [blacked out].

（左侧手写批注：* A.J. 6704 A）
（左下角手写批注：File 0.3342.10.7560/25）

上海档案 B.6704A
上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. I. P. (1935)

D.S. Tcherkashansky

列夫·康斯坦丁诺维奇·特罗菲莫夫（Lev Constantinovitch Trofimoff），俄裔立陶宛公民，1887年8月18日出生于萨拉托夫省卡梅申（Kamishin），于1934年11月底从哈尔滨抵达上海，成为静安寺路126号“东方汽车行”（Oriental Motors）的合伙人，该车行由M. B. 塔克（M. B. Tark）和V. M. 科夫曼（V. M. Koffman）先生所有。特罗菲莫夫凭借前立陶宛领事科特尔-科蒂柳斯（Kotyl-Kotylius）在哈尔滨签发的立陶宛国籍证明书，于1934年11月30日以立陶宛公民身份向本地公安局注册，注册号为15512。众所周知，科特尔-科蒂柳斯会收取一定报酬向任何人签发国籍证明书（档案 D.6827）。对此必须指出，特罗菲莫夫在向公安局注册时，虚假申报其出生地为立陶宛的拉兹维利什基（Radsivillishky）。

特罗菲莫夫租住了卡米尔·洛里路（Route Camil Lories）20号黛西公寓（Daisy Apartments）3室。不久后，他的妻子尼娜·米哈伊洛夫娜·特罗菲莫娃（Nina Mikhailovna Trofimoff）抵达上海，她于1900年6月3日出生于西伯利亚托木斯克。与他们同住的还有特罗菲莫娃夫人的妹妹，姓名不详。

特罗菲莫夫因埃里亚姆·海迪斯（Eriam Haidis）一案引起上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的注意。海迪斯在汉口被中国当局逮捕，原因是他参与了从汉口中国监狱解救第三国际代理人瓦尔登-里韦什（Walden-Rivesh）的阴谋。据报告，特罗菲莫夫是一名优秀的棋手，曾多次被人看见与瓦尔登-里韦什在一起下棋。埃里亚姆·海迪斯在供词中声称，特罗菲莫夫是一名苏联特工，是由[涂黑]当地分支机构航运部的V. [涂黑]，[涂黑]介绍给他的。

（左侧手写批注：* A.J. 6704 A）
（左下角手写批注：File 0.3342.10.7560/25）

Kosseff asked Haidis to obtain certain information about
Japanese Military affairs and pass it on to Trofimoff.

As result of the above informations Trofimoff was invited
to S.M.P. Headquarters on September 19, 1935, and was
questioned by D.S.I. Maklaevsky and D.S. Tcherevshansky.
He stated that he did not know Walden-Rivosh or V. Kossoff,
but that he had met Haidis in connection with his business
as a motor car salesman, and that Haidis had been to his
home.

The following day information was received to the effect
that Trofimoff had expected being arrested and had left for
Tientsin. His wife was later interviewed by D.S.I.
Maklaevsky and stated that Trofimoff left for Tientsin as
he was nervous after being called to Police Headquarters.
She also stated that no communication had been received from
her husband, but that she was expecting a telegram from him
in the near future. In this connection it must be noted
that before he was questioned by Police, Trofimoff purchased
a trunk from Waling Trunk Co., No. 405 Avenue Joffre; this
indicates that he was already preparing to leave Shanghai.

On 29.9.35 Mrs. N. N. Trofimoff vacated her flat at
Daisy Apartments leaving two months rent unpaid. She left
without giving notice to the landlord and did not remove the
furniture from the flat. Mrs. Trofimoff's present where-
abouts are unknown.

On October 8, 1935, Detective Haidis of the French
Police, in company with D.S.I. Maklaevsky, searched the home
of L. G. Trofimoff at Apartment 6, R. 30 Route Haik Road.

科索夫（Kosseff）要求海迪斯获取有关日本军事情报的信息，并将其转交给特罗菲莫夫。

基于上述信息，特罗菲莫夫于1935年9月19日被邀至上海公共租界工部局警务处总部，并由特别巡捕马克拉耶夫斯基（D.S.I. Maklaevsky）和特别巡捕切列夫尚斯基（D.S. Tcherevshansky）进行讯问。他声称不认识瓦尔登-里沃什（Walden-Rivosh）或V. 科索夫（V. Kossoff），但因汽车销售业务而与海迪斯有过接触，且海迪斯曾去过他家。

次日收到情报称，特罗菲莫夫预料自己会被逮捕，已前往天津。随后，特别巡捕马克拉耶夫斯基对特罗菲莫夫的妻子进行了问询，她表示特罗菲莫夫因被传唤至警察总局后感到紧张，故前往天津。她还表示未收到丈夫的任何信件，但预计近期会收到他的电报。对此必须指出，特罗菲莫夫在接受警方讯问前，曾在霞飞路405号华林皮箱公司（Waling Trunk Co.）购买了一只旅行箱；这表明他已在准备离开上海。

1935年9月29日，N. N. 特罗菲莫娃夫人退租了黛西公寓的住所，留下两个月租金未付。她未通知房东便离去，也未将家具从公寓搬走。特罗菲莫娃夫人目前的下落不明。

1935年10月8日，法国警察局的侦探海迪斯会同特别巡捕马克拉耶夫斯基，搜查了L. G. 特罗菲莫夫在海格路30弄6号公寓的住所。所发现的文件（见附译文）表明

Extract from File D.6327 re Katyl-Katylius

Report of D.S. Tcheremshansky
dated November 7, 1935.

Of the many persons in Shanghai who are in possession
of false "Lithuanian Certificates of Nationality" issued by
Kotyl-Kotylius four came in particular to the notice of the
Special Branch i.e. L.C. Trofimoff, suspected Soviet agent
connected with B. Naidis who was arrested in Hankow in
connection with the plot to liberate M. Walden-Rivosh, etc.

摘自关于卡特尔-卡蒂柳斯（Katyl-Katylius）的档案 D.6327

特别巡捕切列姆尚斯基（D.S. Tcheremshansky）的报告
日期：1935年11月7日。

在上海持有由科特尔-科蒂柳斯签发的伪造“立陶宛国籍证明书”的众多人员中，有四人特别引起特别处的注意，即：L.C. 特罗菲莫夫，疑似苏联特工，与B. 奈迪斯（B. Naidis）有关联，后者因参与解救M. 瓦尔登-里沃什（M. Walden-Rivosh）等人的阴谋而在汉口被捕。
